verdict.rationale: Slate documents choosing default models for each slot via the `/models` dialog or `slate.json`. It also offers multiple model sources (ChatGPT/Codex subscription, SuperGrok subscription, or Slate credits) and mixes providers such as Claude, GLM and Codex. Its default is still automatic model selection, so manual choice is an override rather than the primary flow. missing for 10: documented list of selectable models/providers, explicit per-session (vs. per-slot default) switching details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose which underlying AI model powers my session from multiple providers
